title: 激光切割机：考核、授权与预约（国内版）
source_doc: course/Laser Equipment & Safety Training/07_Laser Cutter 7 Wrap Up.md
author_source: project/Laser Equipment & Safety Training/07_Laser Cutter 7 Wrap Up（国内版）/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在桌面式激光切割机旁，手里举着一枚木质徽章
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a closed desktop laser cutter holding up a small wooden badge and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 激光切割培训的最后一课。
overlay: 激光切割机：考核、授权与预约

shots.scene: 测验卷、徽章、日历、签到台四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a blank quiz sheet, a wooden badge, a blank calendar and a front desk. No people.
shots.narration: 考核、授权、预约、签到，一步不少。

shots.scene: 阿杰看完视频，兴冲冲跑到切割机前想直接用
shots.prompt_en: The young male student closes a laptop and hurries over to the laser cutter, ready to use it.
shots.narration: 阿杰看完视频，就想直接上机。

shots.scene: 王老师笑着拦住他，举起空白测验卷
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator smiles, stops the young male student and holds up a blank quiz sheet.
shots.narration: 王老师说：先过考核，才能用。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着屏幕上播放完的视频图标，再指向切割机
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a finished video icon on a blank screen, then at the laser cutter.
shots.narration: 看过演示，还要亲手做一次。

shots.scene: 阿杰坐在桌前答一份空白测验卷
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sits at a desk filling in a blank quiz sheet with a pencil.
shots.narration: 第一步，完成一份安全测验。

shots.scene: 测验卷上的问题都对应着视频图标
shots.prompt_en: Lines from a blank quiz sheet connect to small video icons one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 考的内容，培训里都讲过。

shots.scene: 没通过的卷子旁出现循环箭头，再到打勾
shots.prompt_en: A quiz sheet with a circular retry arrow, then a new quiz sheet with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 没通过就复习再考，直到通过。

shots.scene: 小研翻开一本空白的图文培训手册
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a thick blank training binder with simple pictures on its pages.
shots.narration: 纸质培训手册，内容和视频一样。

shots.scene: 阿杰一边看手册一边点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reads the blank training binder at a desk and nods.
shots.narration: 考试时能查，以后忘了也能翻。

shots.scene: 王老师递给阿杰一张空白说明单和一块薄木板
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands the young male student a blank instruction sheet and a thin wooden sheet.
shots.narration: 通过后，领一张说明单和一块木板。

shots.scene: 阿杰独自站在切割机前操作，小研在一旁观察
shots.prompt_en: The young male student operates the laser cutter on his own while the female graduate student watches from beside him with a blank clipboard.
shots.narration: 独立做出刻着自己名字的刻度尺。

shots.scene: 一张空白卡片上多出一个激光徽章图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank membership card with a small laser badge icon being added to it. No people.
shots.narration: 做完后，在卡上刻一枚激光徽章。

shots.scene: 徽章图标旁边是打勾的切割机图标
shots.prompt_en: The laser badge icon next to a laser cutter icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 这就是你能用这台设备的标记。

shots.scene: 日历上先出现一个徽章项目时段，再出现普通时段
shots.prompt_en: A blank calendar where first one slot is marked with a badge icon, then later slots are marked with a laser cutter icon. No people.
shots.narration: 先预约做徽章项目的时段，

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着带徽章的卡，日历图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds his card with the badge icon next to a calendar icon with a green check.
shots.narration: 考核通过，再预约日常使用。

shots.scene: 电脑屏幕上空白网页，鼠标依次点开菜单
shots.prompt_en: A blank web page on a computer screen; a cursor opens a menu and then a submenu. No people.
shots.narration: 在场馆网站上找到设备预约。

shots.scene: 一列设备图标：缝纫机、刺绣机、切割机等
shots.prompt_en: A list of equipment icons: a sewing machine, an embroidery machine, a vinyl cutter, a laser cutter and a 3D printer. No people.
shots.narration: 就能看到全部可预约的设备。

shots.scene: 多数设备图标上挂着培训证书小图标
shots.prompt_en: Most of the equipment icons have a small training certificate badge attached; only a sewing machine and a microphone do not. No people.
shots.narration: 大多数设备，都要先培训才能用。

shots.scene: 阿杰想预约刺绣机，被提示先参加培训
shots.prompt_en: The young male student points at an embroidery machine icon; a blank training notice pops up beside it.
shots.narration: 想用别的设备，再参加它的培训。

shots.scene: 时间条上一排格子，绿色可选，灰色已约
shots.prompt_en: A row of time slot boxes, green ones free and grey ones taken. No people.
shots.narration: 预约时，点选空闲的绿色时段。

shots.scene: 时钟、每日上限、日历三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a clock, a daily limit bar and a calendar with a forward arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 每格多长、每天多久、能提前几天，

shots.scene: 王老师指着墙上的空白预约规则牌
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a blank booking rules board on the wall.
shots.narration: 都按本场所的规定来。

shots.scene: 屏幕上两个空白输入框和一把锁
shots.prompt_en: A blank login form with two empty input boxes and a padlock icon on the screen. No people.
shots.narration: 用本人账号和密码提交预约。

shots.scene: 阿杰打电话，电话图标旁有问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student makes a phone call with a small question mark icon above him.
shots.narration: 忘了密码，打电话请工作人员帮忙。

shots.scene: 屏幕上两个空白勾选框
shots.prompt_en: A blank form on the screen with two empty check boxes. No people.
shots.narration: 提交前还要回答两个问题。

shots.scene: 阿杰在空白安全承诺书上签字
shots.prompt_en: The young male student signs a blank safety pledge form at a desk.
shots.narration: 是否签了安全承诺书。

shots.scene: 培训证书图标和徽章项目图标二选一
shots.prompt_en: Two options side by side: a training certificate icon and a badge project icon, one getting a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 是否完成培训，或者这次是徽章项目。

shots.scene: 阿杰按时来到服务台，向小研出示卡片
shots.prompt_en: The young male student arrives at a front desk on time and shows his card to the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 到了预约时间，先到服务台签到。

shots.scene: 小研检查阿杰带来的木板和空白表格
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks the wooden sheet the young male student brought and a blank form.
shots.narration: 工作人员检查材料和手续。

shots.scene: 不明材料被拦下，许可木板打勾
shots.prompt_en: An unlabeled plastic sheet is set aside with a red X; the approved wooden sheet gets a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 材料不合规，当场就不能用。

shots.scene: 小研点头放行，阿杰走向切割机
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student nods; the young male student walks toward the laser cutter.
shots.narration: 确认无误，才能上机。

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着小刷子站在打开的切割机旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a small brush beside the open laser cutter.
shots.narration: 用完了，还有最后一步。

shots.scene: 阿杰等机器冷却，用刷子扫出碎屑
shots.prompt_en: The young male student waits for the machine to cool, then sweeps scraps out of the honeycomb bed with a brush.
shots.narration: 等冷却后，清出碎片和残渣。

shots.scene: 碎屑倒入金属垃圾桶
shots.prompt_en: Scrap pieces are emptied into a metal waste bin with a lid. No people.
shots.narration: 碎屑倒进指定的金属桶。

shots.scene: 固定针放回原位，机盖关好，台面整洁
shots.prompt_en: Two pins are put back in their holder, the lid is closed and the bench is tidy. No people.
shots.narration: 工具归位，台面整理干净。

shots.scene: 切割机和净化器的灯依次熄灭
shots.prompt_en: The lights on the laser cutter and the air purifier turn off one after another. No people.
shots.narration: 按规程关闭设备和净化器。

shots.scene: 阿杰在空白使用登记本上填写
shots.prompt_en: The young male student writes in a blank equipment logbook beside the laser cutter.
shots.narration: 填写使用登记：时间、材料、状态。

shots.scene: 异响、冒烟、报警三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a sound wave, a puff of smoke and a flashing warning lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 发现故障、异常或险情，

shots.scene: 阿杰向老李报告，老李挂上故障牌
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reports to the facility engineer, who hangs a blank fault tag on the laser cutter.
shots.narration: 立即报告工作人员，挂牌停用。

shots.scene: 自己拿螺丝刀拆机器的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand opening the laser cutter casing with a screwdriver, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要自己动手拆修。

shots.scene: 小研在服务台后微笑招手
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student smiles and waves from behind the front desk.
shots.narration: 有任何问题，到服务台问工作人员。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在空白白板前，白板上四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard with four icons on it.
shots.narration: 最后，把全课程的安全要点串一串。

shots.scene: 检查卡、蜂窝板、净化器三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a checklist card, a honeycomb bed and an air purifier. No people.
shots.narration: 开机前检查，先开净化器。

shots.scene: 含氯塑料和不明材料图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A plastic sheet with a yellow-green cloud and an unlabeled sheet with a question mark, both crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 含氯塑料、不明材料，一律不切。

shots.scene: 阿杰坐在运行的切割机旁看守
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sits beside the running laser cutter, watching through the tinted window with his hand near the emergency stop.
shots.narration: 运行时一臂之内，全程看守。

shots.scene: 急停按钮、关着的盖子、灭火器、电话119图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a red emergency stop button, a closed lid, a fire extinguisher and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 起火先急停关盖，控制不住拨119。

shots.scene: 镊子夹起木片，旁边有热气图标
shots.prompt_en: Tweezers lift a small wooden piece with heat wave icons above it. No people.
shots.narration: 烟散尽再开盖，冷却后再取件。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现测验卷、徽章、日历图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a quiz sheet, a badge and a calendar.
shots.narration: 先测验，再上机考核，取得资格。

shots.scene: 日历、承诺书、签到台图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a calendar, a signed pledge form and a front desk. No people.
shots.narration: 按规则预约，到场签到接受检查。

shots.scene: 刷子、登记本、故障牌图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a small brush, a blank logbook and a blank fault tag. No people.
shots.narration: 用后清洁、登记，有故障就报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰举着木质徽章挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the young male student hold up small wooden badges and wave goodbye beside the laser cutter.
shots.narration: 取得资格，安全创作，下次见！
